item.title: Version 1.5.7
item.changes: - Filter › Lens Effects: anamorphic flare, starburst, mist, prism, and bokeh in round, hexagon, oval or cat's-eye shapes, all made from the picture's own light. - GIFs play at their real speed and smoothly, and the delay shows the GIF's own milliseconds. - Filter › RGB Split's blur smears both ways, so the image no longer looks shifted.
